description: This file implements a login page component for a Next.js React application, handling user authentication via a form, managing state, and navigating upon successful login.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React component rendering a login form, managing form and error states, handling input changes, form submission, and redirecting after login.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the form state when user types into email or password input fields.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by calling the API, storing tokens, and routing to dashboard on success or displaying errors on failure.
